name: Whiten, resize, recolour upscale
plain: Removes channel correlations with an eigendecomposition of the channel covariance, resizes in decorrelated space, recolours, and can match moments again. Statistics can come from another latent. Unusually rigorous about variance across channels.
math:
C=cov(channels) shrunk: C(1−s)+diag(C)s, +εI
C=VΛVᵀ; w=(x−μ)VΛ^{−½}; w′=resize(w); x′=w′Λ^{½}Vᵀ+μ
moment_match repeats with the output's own covariance
